{{Quote|It is well known that there has been a significant increase in Rebel activity in the Trax Sector.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Heggel]], to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Resner]]|<ref name="GMK" />}}
The '''Trax sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Astrography==
[[File:Trax_sector.jpg|thumb|left|240px|The Trax sector and its surrounding sectors]]
As part of the greater [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Trax sector was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], bordering the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. On the Mid Rim side, it was surrounded by the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar]], [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor]], [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar]], [[Esaga sector/Legends|Esaga]] and [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sectors]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The sector had over 178 [[Star system/Legends|systems]], with ten worlds having developed sentient life. Notable [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Bundim]], [[Draenell's Point]], [[Deysum III]], [[Entrus]], [[Fehern]], [[Jhensrus]], [[Lexrul/Legends|Lexrul]], [[Longwind]],<ref name="GMK" /> [[Essowyn]]<ref name="POG" /> and [[Uogo'cor/Legends|Uogo'cor]].<ref name="GMK" />

The main Navigation route was the [[Trax Tube/Legends|Trax Tube]], which crossed the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and connected the main worlds with [[Randon/Legends|Randon]] in neighboring Mytaranor sector and continued trailing until [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik]] and [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], becoming known as the [[Bothan Run/Legends|Bothan Run]] along the way. The second main route was the [[Terr'skiar Pass]], which connected the sector capitals [[Terr'skiar]] and Deysum III.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Early history===
As part of the politically turbulent Kashyyyk Region, the Trax sector was often controlled by different factions that fought for control over this stretch of space. The area that would later become the Trax sector was first explored between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]], between the [[Kymoodon Era|Kymoodon]] and [[Rianitus Period|Rianitus eras]],<ref name="TEA" /> although colonization would not take place until a much later era.<ref name="GMK" />

Around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the time of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the area was part of what was considered the "civilized galaxy" and was close to the then-borders of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. When [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] waged war on against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Trax sector was part of his [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the height of its might.<ref name="TEA" />

===Old Republic era===
During the last stages of the [[New Sith Wars]], around [[1004 BBY|1004]] to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] the sector was part of Hutt and Sith space and remained under the control of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] during the following millennium.<ref name="TEA" /> The most important planets were settled during this time, but most of the expansion began around [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]]. During the following two centuries, the population grew from five billion to 500 billion, living in a total of 178 inhabited systems, although only 47 of these were officially recognized. [[Deysum III]] was the first planet settled and became a very polluted and industrialized world and the sector's capital. Other big population centers developed on Lexrul and Longwind, while a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang, known as the [[Dark Warbirds]] took over the [[Uogo'cor system/Legends|Uogo'cor system]] and enslaved its native population.<ref name="GMK" /> Subsequently, the system became a well-known [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] as well as [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] port.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Eddel]]ian trade [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of Fehern became a common sight on several neighboring planets.

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began all over the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the Trax sector became a contested area between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Hutts and the Old Republic, but was firmly under Hutt control once again during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Imperial era===
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power, Hutt Space was greatly reduced in size and the Trax sector came under Imperial rule. From Deysum III the Empire not only controlled the Trax sector but also the Coreward parts of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="TEA" /> with a massive [[Trax Sector Group]] of 2,573 ships, five military bases and over one million troops. Battles were fought [[Eddelian-Empire War|against]] the native [[Eddel]], the pirates in the [[Uogo'cor system/Legends|Uogo'cor system]] were wiped out and Lexrul was united.<ref name="GMK" />

[[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] [[Jodo Kast]] and [[Lotas]] had a competitive run-in in the Trax sector, during which Lotas lost his right arm.<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Trax sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />

===Later eras===
After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the sector remained loyal to the Empire proper until the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] advances during [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] After change in government, the New Republic moved the sector capital from Deysum III to Longwind. By [[137 ABY]], the areas was under control of [[Darth Krayt]]'s Sith Empire.<ref name="TEA" />
